The global crypto market cap hits $3.46 trillion, reflecting strong investor confidence. 📈
#CryptoNews #Bitcoin #Ethereum #Dogecoin #Cardano #CryptoMarket #BTC #ETH #DOGE #ADA #CryptoUpdate

Bitcoin (BTC) continues its bullish trend, trading near $110K as geopolitical tensions ease and institutional interest grows. Ethereum (ETH) sees a 3.6% rise, while altcoins like Cardano (ADA) and Dogecoin (DOGE) jump up to 5%.
